title: JWT signing and more reliable text output
body:
Sign JSON Web Tokens directly in your DataWeave scripts with the HMAC and RSA modules. Choose SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512, and add your own headers and claims.

Plain text output now correctly selects fields from inline objects, so expressions like {content: "hello"}.content return just the selected value. Markdown, line breaks, and Unicode characters are preserved. Use output text/plain for text output.
